title: Chapter 261 Large-Scale Battlefield Magic
content:
Chapter 261 Large-Scale Battlefield Magic

The space where the aliens built the space transmission channel. When the light attribute energy shield rose, the energy of the hidden breath disappeared, and the Zerg host was now able to sense the situation.

When Wu Qing found a large number of human mages, he immediately consumed a lot of resources to upgrade 300 three-star Zerg queens.

As soon as those human mages came out of the space transmission channel, they began to cast spells.

The powerful energy fluctuations made Wu Qing feel a little bad.

The Zerg army's defense circle was not too far from the space transmission channel built by the aliens. Wu Qing ordered two hundred five-star Zerg queens to use spawning attacks on two hundred human mages.

The aliens noticed the abnormal state of the two hundred human mages and immediately used the super purification magic driven by the power of light!

By the way, the best app for reading and listening to books at present, Yeguo Reading, install the latest version.

The powerful purification force driven by divine power entered the body of the human mage who was attacked by the Zerg Queen's spawning, and it did have some impact on the newly grown self-destructing parasites.

One side was a fatal blow, and the other side was a divine power-level purification and dispersal, which involved a collision of rule-level forces.

The contest between the two sides delayed the death time of two hundred human mages, giving the alien race hope.

However, the self-destructing parasites' rule of absorbing all energy to evolve themselves still overwhelmed the purification energy as a kind of energy.

The self-destructing parasites absorbed the divine power-level purification energy, grew up and exploded in an instant, and blew the two hundred real elite mages of the alien race into wisps of white light!

"Attack immediately!"

An old human mage shouted hurriedly when he saw this.

But he was still a little late. The three hundred five-star Zerg Queens that had completed the upgrade used spawning attacks on the three hundred human mages including him.

There were less than two hundred human mages left who had not been attacked by the Zerg Queen's eggs.

The already very violent fluctuations in magic energy instantly attenuated by more than half, but supported by a mysterious energy, this powerful magic did not stop.

The remaining more than one hundred human mages finally completed the spell, and they did not need the Zerg Queen to continue attacking. They seemed to have been drained of all their strength and had lost their ability to move.

The magic launched by the alien human race at such a great cost, even if it was repeatedly attenuated, was still very loud.

Wu Qing finally saw the large-scale battlefield magic of this world, and the target of the attack was still the Zerg army.

A huge energy field formed above the Zerg army. At this time, even if the Zerg Queen took action, she didn't know how to interrupt such an attack.

Many dazzling lights suddenly appeared above the Zerg army, falling to the ground as fast as a meteor, with a strange sense of beauty!

The Zerg's defense relies entirely on the body, and there is nothing to prepare. Wu Qing watched helplessly as a large number of light balls fell into the Zerg army, and many light balls even fell into the nearby alien human army.

There was no explosion, only bursts of light, containing powerful purification and annihilation energy, purifying all matter touched.

This is not a complete battlefield magic, and the coverage area is very wide. Fortunately, its lethality is not as strong as imagined. It is still a range attack. It is not easy to kill the Zerg army with a minimum of two-star strength.

"The large-scale battlefield magic of the alien mage, Starfall! I didn't expect it to be used here!"

"This requires the assistance of magic artifacts and a large number of high-star mages to cast a super battlefield magic!"

"The state of this magic is a bit wrong, the power is much weaker, and it seems that it can't hit the soldiers of the Zerg army!"

"Just now, the Zerg should have interfered with the casting of the alien mage. This magic was not fully cast, otherwise, with the strength of the Zerg army, it would not be able to withstand it!"

"..."

Everyone seemed to know the battlefield magic cast by this alien mage.

"Battlefield magic Starfall? I don't know how powerful it is in its complete state!"

Wu Qing felt that the coverage area of this battlefield magic was too large, and the attack power was very scattered, so it could only be used to clean up weak armies.

This incomplete starfall was difficult to kill quickly even a one-star Zerg soldier.

This magic lasted for about twenty seconds and ended. The magic attack almost affected all Zerg armies, but did not cause any casualties in the Zerg army.

Some of the two-star Zerg troops were hurt, which had a little impact on their combat power.

On the contrary, this light-attributed magic energy fell into the alien army, which also cultivated light-attributed energy, and it was a kind of overflow for them.

This increase and decrease strengthened the offensive of the alien army, but it did not play any other role.

This large-scale battlefield magic attack of the aliens was considered a failure, and a trump card was wasted by the Zerg army.

The aliens should have predicted that the spawning attack of two hundred Zerg queens in the Zerg army could kill two hundred human mages, and the surviving human mages were still enough to perform the complete large-scale battlefield magic Stars Fall.

They did not expect that the Zerg army would have another three hundred powerful one-hit kill attacks this time, which completely disrupted their attack plan.

Without the participation of three hundred powerful human mages, the large-scale battlefield magic Starfall this time has become a severely reduced version, with seriously insufficient power.

Perhaps from now on, the alien human race will no longer dare to speculate on the one-hit kill ability of the Zerg army.

"Pah pah pah...!"

The three hundred human mages, with the assistance of super-powerful purification magic, held on until the battlefield magic ended before they exploded and died one after another.

In the end, only the old human mage who had ordered an immediate attack was left, still struggling to support.

Wu Qing saw this situation through the Zerg host and was somewhat expectant: "Being able to hold on for so long under the spawning attack of a five-star Zerg queen, the strength should be six-star!"

He also wanted to see if the six-star strength could withstand the spawning kill of a five-star Zerg queen.

In addition, every time a six-star enemy is killed, the Zerg mother nest is one-tenth closer to upgrading to six stars.

When the Zerg hive is upgraded to six stars, according to the system settings, it can evolve to the final form and unlock all Zerg technologies and arms.

At that time, the system will no longer restrict the Zerg, and the Zerg will truly have the strength of the world's major clans.

Wu Qing is very much looking forward to the arrival of this moment, but now he must do the things in front of him first.

Through the Zerg host, he saw the space transmission channel of the alien human race, and began to continuously transmit troops over.

Perhaps this space transmission channel cannot be transmitted back for the time being, and the nearly 200 human mages who lost their combat power due to the use of the Falling Stars were not sent back, but moved to the side to rest.

Such a good opportunity, Wu Qing must not let it go. The Zerg Queen quietly used the parasitic control ability on the nearly 200 human mages who lost their combat power.

As long as the Zerg Queen does not launch parasitic control, the creatures infected by the parasitic control ability of the Zerg Queen will not feel abnormal.

Wu Qing planned to put aside these nearly 200 powerful alien mages for the time being, and then control them after the battle situation stabilized.

At this time, the alien mage who was suspected to have six-star strength finally couldn't hold on, and died in pain, turning into light and disappearing.

This proved that the difference in strength of one star was not enough to offset the one-hit-kill effect of the Zerg Queen's spawning attack.

The system recorded that the six-star enemies killed became 1/10.

Killing nine more six-star enemies, the development of the Zerg can take off again!

...

The aliens originally wanted to use a big move to push the Zerg army in one wave, but now they failed, and they can only return to the steady path of relying on the advantage of manpower to fight a war of attrition.

At this time, the alien space transmission channel not only transmits the alien army, but also the armies of other affiliated races.

In front of the Zerg army's defense line, the alien army kept charging and falling down. No one hesitated, and no one would retreat. They all looked determined and looked forward to death!

This is the power of faith!

Different gods in the evil god camp have different characteristics of their believers. For example, the fanaticism of the believers of the spirit god and the firmness of the believers of the Lord of Light are more obvious characteristics.

The characteristics of the believers of the upper demons and the god of death are all racial characteristics. The believers of the upper demons are all demons, and Wu Qing, the believer of the god of death, only knows the skeleton tribe for the time being.

The believers of the Lord of Light with firm faith hate the Zerg, a heretic who sacrifices on the battlefield. The alien army, from top to bottom, is determined to eliminate the Zerg at all costs!

On the battlefield, there are constantly joining the alien air forces in the sky, which are restraining the firepower of the Zerg dragons and Zerg hydralisks.

On the ground, a large number of alien cavalry troops use various methods to bypass the restrictions of the Zerg queen trapping net and continue to attack the Zerg army's defense line.

The alien army was constantly destroyed by the powerful long-range firepower of the Zerg army, and then quickly replenished.

The battle situation was deadlocked again in this constant consumption.

After a period of stalemate, a white light appeared in the sky east of the 66th City. Wu Qing looked through the Zerg host and saw that it was a large group of alien light griffins.

A small part of them were powerful light griffin knights. This time they did not hide their bodies and flew directly among the light griffins.

Wu Qing immediately stopped hatching Zerg puppies in the Zerg underground base and changed to hatching a large number of Zerg hydralisks.
